title: Urea 46% N Fertilizer
description: Prilled and granular urea (46-0-0) — the most concentrated solid nitrogen fertilizer, supplied to date palm, vegetable, and cereal growers across Oman.

details.longDescription: Urea (46% N) is the most concentrated solid nitrogen fertilizer available and the primary nitrogen source across Oman's agriculture — date palm plantations in Al Batinah and Al Dakhiliyah, vegetable farms, greenhouse operations, and cereal cropping. Global Chemicals LLC supplies IFDC-standard prilled and granular urea in 25 kg PP bags and 1,000 kg big bags. Applied by broadcast, fertigation through drip irrigation, or foliar spray (0.5–1.0% solution). In Oman's alkaline calcareous soils (pH 7.5–8.5), prompt incorporation or fertigation minimises ammonia volatilisation losses.
applications: Cereal and forage crop broadcast application
Foliar nitrogen spray for stress recovery
Feedstock for urea-formaldehyde and melamine resins
technicalSpecs: Packaging: 25 kg PP bag, 1,000 kg big bag

title: Diammonium Phosphate (DAP 18-46-0)

details.longDescription: Diammonium Phosphate (DAP, 18-46-0) is the world's most widely used phosphorus fertilizer and the primary base-dressing product across Oman. Supplied by Global Chemicals LLC in granular form, DAP delivers 18% nitrogen and 46% P2O5 in a single application — ideal for pre-planting incorporation for vegetables, alfalfa, and date palm root feeding. Fully water-soluble in the root zone and compatible with most nitrogen and potassium fertilizers for custom blending.
applications: Pre-plant base dressing for vegetables and cereals
technicalSpecs: Packaging: 50 kg bag, 1,000 kg big bag

Alfalfa, forage, and cereal crop side-dressing

title: Potassium Chloride (MOP 60% K2O)
description: Muriate of Potash (MOP) — 60% K2O potassium chloride fertilizer for date palms, fruit trees, and field crops across Oman.

details.longDescription: Muriate of Potash (MOP / potassium chloride, 60% K2O) is the most widely used potassium fertilizer in Oman — critical for date palm fruit sizing, quality, and post-harvest storage life, and for tolerance to Oman's saline groundwater. Supplied in standard and granular grades, MOP is applied by broadcast, banding, or fertigation (standard grade fully soluble). Global Chemicals LLC also supplies Sulphate of Potash (SOP, 50% K2O) for chloride-sensitive crops on request.
applications: Date palm potassium fertilization (fruit quality and size)
Fruit tree and citrus potassium programs
Vegetable and forage crop potassium supply

title: Calcium Nitrate Fertilizer
description: Water-soluble calcium nitrate — 15.5% N, 26.5% CaO — the standard calcium and nitrate-nitrogen source for fertigation of tomatoes, cucumbers, and greenhouse crops.

details.longDescription: Calcium Nitrate (15.5% N, 26.5% CaO) is the standard calcium fertilizer for greenhouse and open-field horticulture across Oman — essential for preventing blossom-end rot in tomatoes and peppers, tip-burn in lettuce, and bitter pit in fruit. As the only widely-available calcium source fully compatible with fertigation, it dissolves clearly, delivers nitrate-nitrogen (preferred over ammonium in high-pH substrates), and supports strong cell wall structure. Supplied by Global Chemicals LLC in 25 kg bags for greenhouse growers in Nizwa, Barka, and across Al Batinah.
applications: Foliar calcium spray for fruit quality
Lettuce, cabbage, and brassica calcium supply
technicalSpecs: Packaging: 25 kg bag, 1,000 kg big bag

title: Zinc Sulphate Monohydrate (33% Zn) — Agricultural
description: Micronutrient zinc sulphate — 33% Zn monohydrate — for correcting zinc deficiency in Oman's alkaline soils, date palm, and greenhouse crops.

details.longDescription: Zinc deficiency is one of the most widespread micronutrient problems in Oman's alkaline calcareous soils — reducing yield in date palm, citrus, vegetables, and forage. Zinc Sulphate Monohydrate (33% Zn) is the standard soil and foliar correction. Global Chemicals LLC supplies agricultural-grade ZSM for soil broadcast (20–40 kg/ha), fertigation, and foliar sprays (0.2–0.5% solution). Chelated zinc EDTA also available for high-pH conditions where sulphate fixation is a concern.
applications: Zinc deficiency correction in date palm, citrus, and vegetables

faqs.question: Who supplies zinc sulphate in Oman and the GCC?
faqs.answer: Global Chemicals LLC stocks zinc sulphate monohydrate (33% Zn) in 25 kg bags in Muscat, with same-day Oman dispatch and GCC delivery in 2–7 days. Batch CoA covers zinc assay, sulphur and heavy-metal limits. Agricultural and industrial-grade enquiries both welcome — state your application for the right specification and price.

faqs.question: How is zinc deficiency corrected in Gulf soils?
faqs.answer: The region's alkaline, calcareous soils lock up zinc, showing as interveinal chlorosis and short internodes in date palm, citrus and vegetables. Correct with soil-applied zinc sulphate at 10–25 kg/ha, 0.2–0.5% foliar sprays during active growth, or continuous fertigation dosing. Our agronomy support can interpret your leaf-analysis report and set the programme.

title: Agricultural Gypsum (Calcium Sulphate)
description: Agricultural-grade gypsum (calcium sulphate dihydrate) for sodic soil reclamation, calcium supply, and structure improvement across Oman's irrigated farmland.

details.longDescription: Agricultural Gypsum (CaSO4·2H2O) is the workhorse soil amendment for reclaiming sodic and saline-sodic soils across Oman's irrigated regions — a common problem where saline groundwater raises exchangeable sodium and destroys soil structure. Gypsum supplies soluble calcium that displaces sodium from the cation exchange complex, restoring aggregate structure and water infiltration. Also a non-acidifying calcium and sulphur nutrient source (23% Ca, 18% S) for peanuts, alfalfa, and forage crops. Global Chemicals LLC supplies mined agricultural gypsum in 25 kg bags and 1,000 kg big bags.
applications: Sodic and saline-sodic soil reclamation (2–10 t/ha)
Calcium and sulphur nutrition for peanuts, alfalfa
technicalSpecs: Packaging: 25 kg bag, 1,000 kg big bag, bulk

faqs.question: Who supplies agricultural gypsum in Oman?
faqs.answer: Global Chemicals LLC supplies agricultural-grade gypsum (calcium sulphate dihydrate, 23% Ca, 18% S) in 25 kg and 50 kg bags with bulk tonnage for farm-scale reclamation projects. Same-day Muscat dispatch; delivery across Oman's agricultural regions and GCC export on request. CoA confirms purity and particle size on every lot.

faqs.question: How much gypsum is needed to reclaim sodic soil?
faqs.answer: Typical reclamation rates run 2–10 t/ha depending on exchangeable sodium percentage and soil texture — a soil test converts ESP to a precise gypsum requirement. Apply, incorporate into the top 15–20 cm, then leach with good-quality irrigation water. For maintenance of irrigated ground under saline water, annual rates of 0.5–2 t/ha are common. Send us your soil analysis and we'll calculate the tonnage.

faqs.question: What is the price of agricultural gypsum in Oman?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on volume, bag size and delivery zone — bulk farm-scale tonnage prices substantially below bagged retail. Request a quote with your tonnage and location; we respond with delivered pricing the same business day.

title: Humic Acid (Leonardite Extract)
description: Water-soluble humic and fulvic acids — leonardite-derived soil conditioner that improves nutrient uptake, soil structure, and root growth in Oman's low-organic desert soils.

details.longDescription: Humic acid (leonardite-derived potassium humate) is a powerful soil conditioner for Oman's low-organic-matter desert and irrigated soils. Boosts cation exchange capacity, chelates and mobilises phosphorus and micronutrients (particularly Fe and Zn), improves soil aggregate structure, and stimulates root growth. Compatible with drip fertigation and foliar sprays. Global Chemicals LLC supplies water-soluble flake and powder forms (65–75% humic acid) — ideal for regenerative fertilization programs on date palm, vegetables, and turf.
applications: Component in liquid organic fertilizer blends
